description: Fix Two-Factor Authentication screen for dark mode support (same pattern as FEAT-001) and ensure the QR code display works correctly. The 2FA screen at lib/features/settings/screens/two_factor_auth_screen.dart already has full MFA implementation but uses hardcoded AppColors for backgrounds which breaks in dark mode.
steps: In lib/features/settings/screens/two_factor_auth_screen.dart: Replace Scaffold backgroundColor: AppColors.background with Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor
Replace AppBar backgroundColor: AppColors.surface with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface
Replace AppColors.textPrimary with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface for text widgets
Replace Container fillColor: Colors.white in the OTP TextFormField with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface
Replace the QR code container background Colors.white with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface
Replace secret key container color AppColors.surface with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceVariant or similar
acceptance_criteria: 2FA screen responds to dark mode (dark background, light text)
QR code container and OTP input field use theme-aware colors
All existing 2FA functionality preserved (enroll, verify, unenroll)
verification: Verify the 2FA screen no longer uses hardcoded AppColors.background/surface for scaffolds and containers
findings: Cannot run flutter analyze locally due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. All changes are syntactically correct by manual review. Replaced AppColors.background, AppColors.surface, AppColors.textPrimary, AppColors.textSecondary, AppColors.textHint, AppColors.border, and Colors.white (for container/fill backgrounds) with Theme.of(context) equivalents. Used surfaceVariant (not surfaceContainerHighest) for the secret key container since Flutter 3.19 does not have surfaceContainerHighest. Kept AppColors.primary/success/warning/error as they are semantic accent colors shared across both themes. All MFA logic (enroll, verify, unenroll, challenge) is completely unchanged.
